Working primarily in Microsoft Azure, the engineer owns AI platform configuration, hosted model deployments and endpoints, access controls, observability, capacity, costs, and production readiness, with additional responsibility for approved AI services in AWS, Google Cloud, and vendor environments. The role provides secure, reusable capabilities for AI applications and agents and partners with Data Engineering on governed access to enterprise information. This is a hands-on platform engineering and operations role, not a model-training or application feature-development role. Partners with security, cloud, identity, privacy, governance, and engineering teams to implement approved identity, least-privilege access, network-access, secrets-management, and logging controls. Builds secure, reusable platform access patterns for approved enterprise data and knowledge sources, preserving source permissions and implementing approved confidentiality controls. Defines service health indicators, alerting, runbooks, rollback procedures, and production-readiness criteria; tests changes before release and maintains lifecycle and recovery plans. Authors technical standards, reference architectures, and operational documentation; participates in architecture reviews and delivers training and technical guidance to solution teams. Serves as a technical advisor to vendors, stakeholders, and solution teams and provides guidance on platform design and operations. Appears on camera for meetings with colleagues and vendors. Strong production operations skills, including observability, alerting, incident response, root-cause analysis, change management, capacity planning, and recovery. Ability to build and maintain reusable infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Terraform or Bicep and adopt the firm’s approved tooling and engineering standards. Proficiency in Python and/or PowerShell for API-driven provisioning, configuration, operational automation, and troubleshooting. Experience with Git, code review, and CI/CD pipelines, including testing, deployment approvals, secure configuration, and rollback. Practical knowledge of Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, secrets management, private connectivity, DNS, and least-privilege access. Understanding of APIs, search, indexing, and retrieval patterns sufficient to enable platform integration and troubleshoot with data and application engineers. Understanding of governed data access, source permissions, confidentiality, and safeguards for sensitive information in platform telemetry. Ability to analyze usage attribution, cost, performance, quotas, and capacity and implement practical optimization and cost-control measures. Strong problem-solving, documentation, communication, and delivery skills; ability to collaborate with vendors and technical and non-technical stakeholders. Education & Prior Experience Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, or AI infrastructure roles. Hands-on experience building and operating Microsoft Azure services in an enterprise production environment, including deployment, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management. Production experience operating at least one managed AI or large language model platform, such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or an equivalent service. Demonstrated delivery of infrastructure-as-code, Python and/or PowerShell automation, and Git-based controlled deployment pipelines. Experience with AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or comparable platforms preferred. Docker/Kubernetes experience and relevant cloud or AI certifications are a plus. Experience working in a professional services organization strongly preferred. Law firm experience a plus. Physical Requirements While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to move from workstation or desk, throughout the work area to work independently or with a team, to meet with colleagues or supervisor and retrieve work assignments.
